# mailclad

> Audit package-manager security settings and advisories across monorepos and folders of projects.

## Install

```
bun install -g mailclad
```

Requires Bun on PATH. Standalone binaries are on GitHub Releases.

## Commands

See https://mailclad.dev/docs/commands for flags generated from the CLI catalog.

- Site: https://mailclad.dev
- Docs: https://mailclad.dev/docs
